observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment process resources, coherence owner trace, and capability intelligence

outcome.effectiveness_assessment: The Environment now samples bounded scheduler-process counters around existing owner runners and preserves deltas beside exact execution identities in owner trace and ECI schema 5. This closes an observability gap for future runs. No claim is made that a service fulfilled an agent need, used fewer resources, or reduced agent work.
outcome.interpretation_limit: A subsequent real owner execution is needed before the new per-owner measurements can inform resource-cost interpretation.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner executions lack bounded process-resource evidence
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment resource observation, coherence scheduling, and ECI
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An earlier resident process sample recorded high I/O and memory use but ended before a trace was available, while current owner-pass projections correlated execution IDs and elapsed time without process counters.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Sample the scheduler process around existing owner runners, link deltas to exact service execution IDs, retain a bounded ECI view, and make process and child-process attribution limits explicit.

improvement_relation.basis: Targeted tests connect real procfs sampling, owner-runner deltas, trace projection, and bounded ECI owner summaries while preserving the exact execution identity and explicit measurement limits.
not_measured: Per-owner resource deltas from a fresh operational run.
Child-process resource consumption or host-wide attribution.
Whether the observed process activity was necessary to fulfill an agent need.
Whether the change reduced resource consumption, execution time, or agent intervention.
Whether any filesystem metadata pressure or Btrfs incident was caused by the observed process activity.

measurement_limits: The readback is a tested projection fixture; a fresh ambient tick is needed to establish live operational observation.
Counter deltas correlate with an owner execution interval but do not establish that the owner caused all measured work.
Service fulfillment, agent receipt, burden reduction, and longer-term effectiveness remain unmeasured.
